feedback_text.text: In the first couple of questions I was merely guessing since I had no data to back up what would be the most accurate indicators. But I wrote down and tracked which features each of the pictures had and the associated ranking and was able to correlate from there. I merely used the average numbers I got from my results to influence my answers in the following questions. Through this, I figured that both the stripe direction and feet webbing/curliness mattered for fertility and that there was a preference for stripes that go up and to the left and for webbed feet. Neither of these features was found to be essential though, just having either of those boosted the average fertility of the reptiles.
